caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical wooden container with an open top. The surface of the container is smooth, and the wood grain is clearly visible in varying shades of brown and tan, with darker and lighter streaks running vertically along the exterior. The inside of the container is visible from the top, showing a shadowed interior with a similar brown color but slightly darker due to shading. The overall shape is a slightly oblong vertical cylinder, and there are no additional decorative elements, handles, or markings besides the natural wood grain pattern. The background is blank, emphasizing the container as the sole object in the composition.
title: Flour Barrel
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
